Responsibilities
 Are you eager to take your career to the next level? If yes, we encourage your application for Technical Support Representative with Italian role! In this role, you will act as the primary technical point of contact for customers and other departments, supporting product selection, quotation preparation in SAP, replacement identification and application troubleshooting across the Fluid Automation portfolio. You will help ensure a positive customer experience by providing timely, accurate, and compliant technical support while maintaining strong product knowledge and collaboration across functions. In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
Providing technical support for Fluid Automation products and solutions to customers, distributors, business partners and sales representatives
Managing customer enquiries received via Salesforce, SAP, email and phone, ensuring timely and professional communication in Italian and English
Creating, processing and following up quotations in SAP, including pricing, availability, lead times and product configurations
Identifying and recommending replacement products, alternative solutions and successor part numbers for obsolete, discontinued or non-standard products
Supporting customers with product identification, part number validation, configuration review and interpretation of technical specifications
Providing application support and troubleshooting assistance for pneumatic, fluid control and automation products installed in the field
Performing technical product equivalencies and cross-references with competitor products, proposing suitable alternative solutions when applicable
Coordinating with Product Managers, Customer Service, Supply Chain and Data Quality teams to ensure accuracy and consistency of technical and product-related information
Maintaining accurate records of customer interactions, quotations and technical activities in SAP and Salesforce
Continuously developing product and application knowledge across the Fluid Automation portfolio, including new product introductions, product lifecycle changes, replacement products and obsolescence management
Supporting knowledge sharing and training activities for Customer Service and internal stakeholders when required
Identifying recurring customer issues, reporting anomalies, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives
Ensuring full compliance with Quality, Environmental, and International Trade Compliance requirements.
 Who You Are: You gain insight into customer needs. You research initiatives and try new approaches. You seek out experts and innovators to learn about the impact emerging technologies might have on your business. You provide timely and helpful information to individuals across the organization.
 For This Role, You Will Need
Relevant technical knowledge or hands-on experience
1-3 years of experience in technical support, customer support, technical customer service, or a similar role
Practical understanding of pneumatic cylinders and valves
Proficiency in Italian and English
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to work under time pressure and manage multiple priorities
Team-oriented mindset and customer-focused approach. 
 Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart
Experience supporting customers with product selection, replacement identification, and technical troubleshooting
Knowledge of pneumatic systems, fluid automation products, valve technology, FRL equipment, manifolds and related industrial automation solutions
Previous experience in technical support, customer support, application engineering, or a related industrial environment
Basic knowledge of automation, process control, or industrial applications
Experience with SAP, Salesforce, MS Office and Outlook
Knowledge of international trade processes, Incoterms, and commercial documentation.
 Our Culture & Commitment to You: At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives - because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
